summary: State Street Corporation filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an offering of depositary shares representing a 1/100th interest in its Series L Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The filing is an ordinary securities offering, not a special situation. Terms include a $100,000 liquidation preference per preferred share ($1,000 per depositary share), quarterly non-cumulative dividends, and issuer redemption options after September 15, 2031. No M&A, restructuring, or other special-situations event is present. The registrant acts solely as issuer of equity securities.
